overview.headlineHtml: Seven villas, walking distance from the sea
copy: Cortijo Blanco Villa Collection is a gated enclave of seven independent villas in Cortijo Blanco, one of the established residential pockets between San Pedro de Alcántara and Puerto Banús. The beach promenade, the restaurants along it, the centre of San Pedro and Puerto Banús itself are all reachable on foot.

Each villa is arranged over three floors and a rooftop. The ground floor opens the kitchen, living and dining areas onto a covered terrace, a barbecue terrace and a 56 m² pool. Four en-suite bedrooms sit above and below: the master and two more on the first floor, a fourth beside the basement family room. A lift serves all three levels, and an optional rooftop solarium adds a further 139.85 m² with its own pool and pergola.

why.copy: Villas this size, in a gated setting, within walking distance of both the beach and Puerto Banús are the scarce end of the Marbella market. Cortijo Blanco is already built out, so the supply does not repeat.
points: Walk to the sea, not drive
The promenade, its restaurants, San Pedro centre and Puerto Banús are all on foot from the gate.
A private road with a community gate serving seven houses, each on its own 812-1,004 m² plot.
The specification names the brands: Bulthaup kitchens, Bang & Olufsen sound, Lutron control, Technal glazing, Fantini fittings.
Every staged payment made against the house is guaranteed by an insurance policy, as Spanish off-plan law requires.

copy: The architecture is contemporary but restrained, built around double-height volumes, deep covered terraces and full-height glazing that puts the garden and pool at the centre of the plan.
highlights: Continuous cement mortar finished in exterior paint, with travertine-effect ceramic detailing.
Engineered wood to the ground-floor covered terraces.
Technal Lumeal minimal-profile aluminium with thermal break and laminated double glazing.
Large-format 120 x 120 cm porcelain, the same tile continued from inside onto the terraces and pool surround.
Laminated glass with button fixings to the first-floor terraces and stair edges.
Dimmable scenes throughout, integrated into the home automation.

residences.copy: Every villa has the same accommodation. The differences between plots are in the garden, the terraces and the approach, not in the house.
items: Kitchen 27.40 m², living area 41.98 m², hall, guest toilet, covered terrace, barbecue terrace, 56.41 m² pool and a covered garage for two cars.
Master bedroom 22.13 m² with dressing room and 8.80 m² bathroom, plus bedrooms 2 and 3, each en-suite, opening to two terraces.
Family room 72.47 m², bedroom 4 at 23.09 m² en-suite, laundry, storage and plant room, lit by an English patio.
A further 139.85 m² with its own pool, pergola and terraces, priced at €149,500 + VAT and included in the released villas.

lifestyle.copy: The pool sits between the house and the garden, with a water curtain falling from the first-floor terrace and a covered pool bar pre-plumbed for an outdoor kitchen.
panels: 56.41 m² pool with two depths, a decked lounging area and crossed garden steps to the pool bar.
Covered recreation area on the ground-floor terrace, pre-installed for a kitchen and bar.
Optional floor with its own pool, pergola, lounge and dining areas, and views to the mountains.
383-391 m² of landscaped garden with zoned automatic irrigation and a water tank.

faq: Seven villas make up the development, in two phases. Villas 1 and 3, both in Phase 2, are the released houses at the moment. We confirm the current position with the developer before any viewing.
Is the solarium included in the price?
Yes. The rooftop solarium is an optional floor priced at €149,500 + VAT, and it is included in the quoted prices for both released villas.
When will the villas be finished?
Delivery is expected in Q4 2026. The developer’s sales conditions allow eighteen months from the start of works: fifteen for construction and three for the first-occupation licence.
No. Prices are quoted excluding VAT. VAT applies to every instalment except the 5% reservation deposit.
